fields.dft_notes: A2B is a protocol; scan/DFT topology is a property of a concrete AD24xx transceiver implementation, not of the A2B protocol itself. In-system diagnostics (line-fault, power-fault, lock-status, interrupt aggregation) provide field observability over (tunneled) I2C.
